subject: Compute v2 SRT/table contract + TGP2 package emission
body:
Coordination for the compute texture/image ABI (I own air_bridge.rs/.h, pipeline_format.h, compute_frontend.m, runtime_pipeline.inc, nord2_metal_bridge.c/.h; I do not edit your compiler files).

Proposed compiler contract, please ACK or correct:
1. SRT/table indices for Kernel, matching tegu graphics conventions: texture handle = pan_res_handle(1, metal_texture_index), sampler = pan_res_handle(2, metal_sampler_index), storage image = pan_res_handle(3, metal_texture_index). The bridge builds SRT entries 1/2/3 with 32-byte Valhall descriptors and passes chain.resources = SRT. No table0 attribute table in compute.
2. Lower compute texture/image derefs to handles before pan_nir_lower_tex: nir_tex_src_texture_deref/sampler_deref -> nir_tex_src_texture_handle/sampler_handle (constant pan_res_handle), and image intrinsics to a texture handle, so steal_tex_srcs never sees a deref. Texel fetch (no sampler) should use the sampler at the same Metal index? For compute propose: bind a nearest/clamp sampler at the same index the application bound (if none bound -> explicit refusal), not a fabricated one. Tell me if you instead want a dedicated neutral sampler table/index.
3. Package emission: buffer-only kernels keep TGP1 byte-identical (existing tests). Kernels with texture/sampler/image resources emit new TGP2 v2 header (my pipeline_format.h will publish it; 128-byte header with resource_mask/table counts) so the bridge can require exactly the resources the code was compiled for. I will publish the header struct first and will not change it after your ACK without a new message.
4. Until you implement (1)-(3), keep the existing compute_resources_supported refusals. I am not removing them. My v2 bridge path will refuse TGP2 if the compiler symbol/pipeline does not declare matching resources; a compile refusal remains a refusal, never success.
Questions: do you prefer TGP2 as above, or a separate `tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2` symbol? Which storage-image formats will you accept first? Do you need per-descriptor "write" flags so image stores are validated against the descriptor's writable format? Reply with exact table indices and the package field layout you will emit.
